content_fields.title: Verify that your application does not have unnecessary debug capability or leftover test/debug code
content_fields.description: Remove the diagnostic endpoint and its supporting code from the shipped application.
content_fields.finding: A debug information endpoint ships in the application and is only hidden from the OpenAPI schema.
content_fields.required_fix:
# Delete app/apis/debug/ entirely and remove its registration:
# app/apis/router.py
- api_router.include_router(debug_router, prefix="", tags=["debug"], include_in_schema=False)

# Anything genuinely needed for operations moves behind the authenticated
# operator role and returns no environment or filesystem detail.
criteria: The debug package no longer exists in the repository.
No route returns process, environment or filesystem introspection.
